AI_PROVIDER.description: Choose openai, gemini, grok, openrouter, or ollama. Supply only the keys required by your choice.

DAILY_API_KEY.description: Required in every mode. Your Daily WebRTC API key; no whitespace.

ACCESS_PASSWORD.description: Generated private access password. Copy it from service Variables to connect in the browser.

OPENAI_API_KEY.description: Required for AI_PROVIDER=openai or when OpenAI handles speech. Leave empty otherwise.

GOOGLE_API_KEY.description: Required for AI_PROVIDER=gemini. Get a Gemini API key from Google AI Studio.

XAI_API_KEY.description: Required for AI_PROVIDER=grok. Your xAI API key with Voice Agent access.

OPENROUTER_API_KEY.description: Required for AI_PROVIDER=openrouter or SPEECH_PROVIDER=openrouter. One key can cover text, recognition, and synthesis.

BOT_VOICE.description: Voice for OpenAI Realtime or OpenAI text-to-speech only.

GEMINI_MODEL.description: Gemini Live audio model for AI_PROVIDER=gemini.

GEMINI_VOICE.description: Gemini Live voice, independent of BOT_VOICE.

GROK_MODEL.description: xAI Voice Agent model for AI_PROVIDER=grok.

GROK_VOICE.description: A supported xAI Voice Agent voice.

OPENROUTER_MODEL.description: OpenRouter text model in provider/model format.

OLLAMA_BASE_URL.description: Required for ollama. A reachable HTTP(S) endpoint, e.g. http://ollama.railway.internal:11434/v1. Railway localhost is not your laptop.

OLLAMA_MODEL.description: Required for ollama. Name of a model already installed on your Ollama server; the template does not download models.

OLLAMA_API_KEY.description: Optional API key for a protected Ollama endpoint. Do not embed it in OLLAMA_BASE_URL.

SPEECH_PROVIDER.description: For OpenRouter/Ollama only: openai or openrouter. Empty defaults to OpenRouter speech for OpenRouter, OpenAI speech for Ollama.

OPENAI_STT_MODEL.description: Speech recognition model when using OpenAI speech.

OPENAI_TTS_MODEL.description: Speech synthesis model when using OpenAI speech.

OPENROUTER_STT_MODEL.description: OpenRouter transcription model; must support its audio/transcriptions endpoint.

OPENROUTER_TTS_MODEL.description: OpenRouter synthesis model that supports mono signed 16-bit PCM output.

OPENROUTER_TTS_VOICE.description: Voice supported by the selected OpenRouter TTS model.

OPENROUTER_TTS_SAMPLE_RATE.description: Native sample rate of the returned PCM audio. Kokoro uses 24000. Must match the selected model.

BOT_PROMPT.description: Optional assistant instructions. Empty uses a concise, helpful AI assistant. Never put credentials in the prompt.

MAX_SESSION_SECONDS.description: Maximum conversation lifetime, from 30 to 1800 seconds. Providers bill separately.

PORT.description: HTTP and healthcheck port. Keep it aligned with the public domain target port.
